typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ResultSet = CAST(CONCAT(UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,\'|\',CLAIM_NUMBER,\'|\',NDC,\'|\',BRAND_NAME,\'|\',GENERIC_NAME,\'|\',GENERIC_DISPENSED,\'|\',DRUG_CLASS,\'|\',DOSAGE,\'|\',DAYS_SUPPLY,\'|\',PRESCRIBER_NPI,\'|\',PRESCRIBER_NAME_LAST,\'|\',PRESCRIBER_NAME_FIRST,\'|\',PRESCRIBER_NAME_MIDDLE ,\'|\',FILLED_BY_PHARMACY_NAME,\'|\',PAID_AMOUNT,\'|\',BILLED_AMOUNT,\'|\',COPAY_AMOUNT,\'|\',COINSURANCE_AMOUNT,\'|\',DEDUCTIBLE,\'|\',PRESCRIPTION_WRITTEN_DATE,\'|\',FILLED_DATE) AS VARCHAR(MAX)) 		FROM EXTRACT.MINDOULA_STAGE_PHARMACY 	   WHERE (ROW_INDICATOR = \'HEADER\' 	      OR  GRGR_CK = ?) 	   ORDER BY ROW_INDICATOR DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetPharmacyData
GetPharmacyData derive(ResultSet = ResultSet) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ResultSet as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ResultSet)) ~> PharmacyFileOutbound
